title: OmnisVigil Ingest Record (v1)
description: One content-free per-request record pushed from OmnisRouter to the OmnisVigil collector (POST /v1/ingest). Extends the persisted DecisionLogEntry with actual usage, actual cost, a router id, and attribution tags. Never carries prompt/response text or API keys.

id.description: Idempotency key, one per request. Vigil dedupes on this.

router_id.description: Which router deployment emitted this, for fleet attribution.

session_id.description: Router session grouping, not a user identity.

request_hash.description: Non-reversible hash of the request. NOT prompt content.

policy_version.description: Routing-model build id that produced the decision.

est_cost_delta_vs_big_usd.description: Estimated saving vs the strongest candidate.

actual_cost_usd.description: Real spend from actual usage and the pinned pricing snapshot. Null when no call completed (cancelled / upstream_error).

actual_cost_delta_vs_big_usd.description: Real per-request saving vs the strongest candidate. The savings-ledger number. Null when no call completed.

usage.description: Actual token accounting. Null when no call completed.

tags.description: Caller-supplied attribution labels, all optional, content-free, each capped at 200 chars by the router.

cache_waste.description: Content-free prompt-cache hygiene block (OmnisRouter 004). Present only when analysis ran; absent (block omitted) when measurement is off, the request is non-cacheable, it is first-in-lineage, or an off-path analysis was dropped. A record without it is byte-identical to a v1 record (SC-007). Scalars and labels only, never prompt bytes, diff, or keys.

cause_class.description: Classified reason the cache prefix diverged.

recomputed_tokens.description: Tokens paid at cache-write price on this miss, from real usage.

waste_gbp.description: Avoidable-miss cost in GBP; 0 when unavoidable (the reporting side relies on this).

fix_applied.description: The normaliser the router applied before dispatch, or null when none.

saved_tokens.description: Tokens the fix turned write into read (0 when no fix).

saved_gbp.description: Value of saved_tokens at (write - read) price in GBP.

pricing_version.description: Pricing snapshot date used for the figures.

fx_date.description: Date of the USD to GBP rate applied.

usd_gbp.description: The USD to GBP rate applied.

shadow_price.description: True on a subscription: a shadow figure, never a bill.
